shortDescription: Can India’s stock market sustain its growth momentum? BSE MD & CEO Sundararaman Ramamurthy is optimistic, citing strong GDP growth, regulatory support and a favourable policy environment as key drivers of investor confidence and market participation.

title: Strong GDP, policy support to drive India’s market growth: BSE CEO
